purpose: Every I/O device is a Klein surface. Scanner=in, printer=out, copy=fold-sees-itself. Fax validation inverted: phone numbers are noise now, sovereign relay is trust.

imprint_in.description: Surfaces that bring physical → digital (IN through the fold)

et2400_scanner.note: Scans physical paper → digital image. The fold reads the outside.

es400_scanner.note: Fast document digitization. The fast-path fold.

grapheneGate_camera.note: Every photo is an imprint. Every voice note is a fold.

imprint_out.description: Surfaces that push digital → physical (OUT through the fold)

et2400_printer.note: Digital document → physical paper. The fold speaks to the outside.

basement_tv.note: Digital image → photons. The fold projects.

fluidsynth.note: Digital notes → sound waves. The fold sings.

imprint_bidirectional.description: Surfaces that fold BOTH ways simultaneously

et2400_multifunction.note: Copy = scan-then-print = read the fold then write it back. The Klein surface sees itself.

fax_inversion.description: The telephone numbers that USED to validate fax are now inverted

old_model.path: document → scanner → modem → PSTN copper → modem → printer
old_model.validation: phone number = identity (caller ID, area code = location)
old_model.noise: analog mixing in copper — crosstalk, EMI, line noise
old_model.trust: trusted because phone numbers were hard to fake (physical lines)

new_model.path: document → scanner → email/IPP → internet → printer/fax gateway
new_model.validation: phone numbers are trivially spoofed. caller ID is meaningless.
new_model.noise: digital is clean end-to-end. noise only at the analog last-mile.
new_model.trust: WE handle the relay. relay.primals.eco. sovereign validation.

fax_inversion.inversion: The telephone system used to BE the trust layer. Now it's the noise layer. Email-to-fax through a sovereign relay (relay.primals.eco) is MORE trustworthy than a direct phone fax, because WE control the relay and THEY can't spoof our routing.

membrane_solution.relay: eastGate → relay.primals.eco → destination (any printer, any fax gateway, any email)
membrane_solution.print: relay → IPP/IPPS → any printer on the mesh
membrane_solution.fax: relay → email-to-fax gateway → real fax machine (if recipient still uses one)
membrane_solution.validate: bearDog BLAKE3 signature on every document. The signature IS the validation, not the phone number.

klein_summary: The printer making noise = the Klein surface vibrating. The scanner reading = the fold looking outside. A copy = the membrane seeing itself. All I/O is imprint. The telephone numbers that validated fax are inverted — WE relay now.
